doc: Lua 5.4 scripting API of the Project 8 Plus script-mod host. docs/modding/scripting.md explains it; this file drives the editor's autocomplete and reference pane.

entries.name: qb
entries.doc: THP8's QB script VM: call scripts / CFunctions / member functions, read and set globals, define QB functions in Lua.

entries.name: qb.call
entries.doc: Runs a QB script, CFunction or (with object) member function on the game thread, like the game's own SpawnScriptNow. params: table (array part = unnamed params in order, named keys = name = value, true = a bare flag). Returns the params the callee returned (table) and its boolean result. If the callee waits over frames: inside a task the task waits for it, outside it returns nil, false, "pending".

entries.name: qb.call_on
entries.doc: qb.call on an object: object:Name params. object = a name ("Skater", a ped's id) or qb.key.

entries.name: qb.spawn
entries.doc: Starts a script and returns at once. handle.done, handle.result, handle.ok; handle:wait() inside a task waits until it ends.
entries.example: local h = qb.spawn("goal_dialog_box", {title = qb.wstr("Hi"), text = qb.wstr("...")})

entries.name: qb.register
entries.doc: Defines a new QB CFunction whose body is Lua. QB code (scripts, pad_choose_script, callbacks) can call it by name. fn gets the call's params as a table and ctx = {name, script, object_addr, call(name, params)} (ctx:call runs a member function on the calling object). Return nothing (= true), a boolean, a table of values added to the caller's params, or table, boolean.

entries.name: qb.override
entries.doc: Like qb.register, but replaces an existing script / CFunction of the game; the original comes back when the mod is unloaded. Use for global scripts only (not ones a level file defines).

entries.name: qb.script
entries.doc: Defines a real QB script made of calls: steps = list of "Name" or {"Name", params, object?}. The game runs it like its own scripts (spawned, as a callback, or as a camera ControlScript on the camera object). Redefining replaces it.

entries.name: qb.key
entries.doc: A QB checksum (name). Keys compare with ==, print as their name when known. Strings "#name" in params are also checksums.

entries.name: qb.is
entries.doc: True if two names / keys are the same checksum (case-insensitive).

entries.name: qb.vec
entries.doc: A 3D vector (QB vector). Supports + - * (number), :len(), :dist(v), :dot(v), :unpack().

entries.name: qb.pair
entries.doc: A QB pair (2D), e.g. screen positions (640x480 space) and scales.

entries.name: qb.float
entries.doc: Forces a float parameter (Lua integers are sent as QB integers).

entries.name: qb.wstr
entries.doc: A wide (UTF-16) string, which the game's UI text expects.

entries.name: qb.global
entries.doc: A reference to a QB global ($name) in params: the game resolves it when the call runs, so the callee gets the real struct or array (e.g. trick animation data) instead of a Lua copy. Always use it for trick data (AnimData): qb.call checks GrabTrick / fliptrick / InvertTrick / manual params and refuses incomplete ones, which would hang the game.

entries.name: qb.exists
entries.doc: The type of a global symbol: "script", "cfunc", "int", "float", "string", "struct", "array", "name", ... or nil.

entries.name: qb.get_global
entries.doc: Reads a QB global (int, float, string, name, struct, array).

entries.name: qb.set_global
entries.doc: Sets an existing int / float / name global in place.

entries.name: qb.get_field
entries.doc: Reads one member of a global struct.

entries.name: qb.set_field
entries.doc: Sets an int / float / name member of a global struct in place. Most tuning structs are read live by the game.

entries.name: events
entries.doc: Game and mod events. Handlers run on the game thread; an error in one handler is logged and does not stop the others.

entries.name: events.on
entries.doc: Subscribes to an event: a named game event, "frame", "script:<QB script>", "cfunc:<CFunction>", "event:<game event>" or a mod event (events.emit).

entries.name: events.once
entries.doc: Like events.on, for the next occurrence only.

entries.name: events.off
entries.doc: Removes a handler.

entries.name: events.emit
entries.doc: Delivers an event to this mod's own handlers and wait_event waiters.

entries.name: events.define
entries.doc: Defines a derived event: while someone listens to name, every source event is passed through fn (nil = skip). The built-in named events are made this way.
entries.example: events.define("big_air", "air_end", function(e) if e.time > 2 then return e end end)

entries.name: task
entries.doc: Runs fn as a coroutine on the game thread; it can wait without blocking the game.
entries.example: task(function() wait(2); hud.message("two seconds later") end)

entries.name: wait
entries.doc: Inside a task: waits (host seconds).

entries.name: wait_frames
entries.doc: Inside a task: waits n game frames.

entries.name: wait_until
entries.doc: Inside a task: waits until fn() is true (checked each frame); nil on timeout.

entries.name: wait_event
entries.doc: Inside a task: waits for an event (optional filter(payload) -> bool); nil on timeout.
entries.example: local c = wait_event("trick_landed", function(c) return c.score > 1000 end, 60)

entries.name: skater
entries.doc: The local skater.

entries.name: skater.exists
entries.doc: True while a local skater exists (in a level).

entries.name: skater.pos
entries.doc: World position.

entries.name: skater.vel
entries.doc: Velocity (world units per second).

entries.name: skater.speed
entries.doc: Length of the velocity.

entries.name: skater.id
entries.doc: The skater object's id (the source of its events).

entries.name: skater.object
entries.doc: Guest address of the skater object (for mem.*).

entries.name: skater.score
entries.signature: skater.score() -> {total, base, mult, combo, last, special}|nil
entries.doc: The run's score: total, the current combo (base x mult = combo), the last score landed, the special meter.

entries.name: skater.set_score
entries.doc: Sets the run's total score.

entries.name: skater.add_score
entries.doc: Awards points to the run's total.

entries.name: skater.teleport
entries.doc: Moves the skater (Skater:Obj_SetPosition).

entries.name: skater.to_node
entries.doc: Moves the skater to a level node (TeleportSkaterToNode).

entries.name: skater.physics.get
entries.doc: A member of the skater_physics tuning struct.

entries.name: skater.physics.set
entries.doc: Sets a skater_physics member (read live by the game).

entries.name: hud
entries.doc: On-screen text and dialogs in the game's own UI.

entries.name: hud.message
entries.signature: hud.message(text, {time, pos, scale, rgba, id, style}?)
entries.doc: A panel message (create_panel_message). time in ms; pos = qb.pair in 640x480 space; id = reuse to replace the previous one.

entries.name: hud.dialog
entries.doc: The game's dialog box; a button runs its fn and closes the dialog.

entries.name: hud.close_dialog
entries.doc: Closes the dialog box.

entries.name: hud.speech
entries.doc: The game's speech box (NPC talk bubble).

entries.name: hud.close_speech
entries.doc: Closes the speech box.

entries.name: sound.play
entries.doc: Plays a loaded sound by name (PlaySound).

entries.name: sound.stop
entries.doc: Stops a sound (StopSound).

entries.name: sound.music_volume
entries.doc: Music volume (SetMusicVolume).

entries.name: sound.skip_track
entries.doc: Next music track.

entries.name: goals.start
entries.doc: Starts a goal: a modding-kit goal through p8q_goal_start, a stock goal through GMan_ActivateGoal.

entries.name: goals.stop
entries.doc: Deactivates a goal.

entries.name: goals.won
entries.doc: True if the goal was won.

entries.name: goals.active
entries.doc: Whether a goal is active, or (no id) the active goal's id.

entries.name: goals.exists
entries.doc: True if the goal manager knows the goal.

entries.name: goals.unlock
entries.doc: Unlocks a goal.

entries.name: goals.lock
entries.doc: Locks a modding-kit goal.

entries.name: goals.list
entries.doc: Ids of the modding-kit goals installed.
entries.example: for _, g in ipairs(goals.list()) do log.info(tostring(g)) end

entries.name: goals.config
entries.doc: A modding-kit goal's settings (p8q_goal_cfg).

entries.name: goals.last_result
entries.doc: The last modding-kit goal that ended and how (won / failed / quit).

entries.name: camera.play
entries.doc: Plays an in-game camera animation (PlayIGCCam).

entries.name: camera.stop
entries.doc: Stops a camera animation (KillSkaterCamAnim).

entries.name: input.held
entries.doc: The local skater's pad button is down. X Square Circle Triangle L1 R1 L2 R2 Up Down Left Right.

entries.name: input.watch
entries.doc: Polls these buttons each frame and sends "button" events {button, down}.

entries.name: game.frame
entries.doc: Game frame counter.

entries.name: game.time
entries.doc: Host clock (seconds).

entries.name: game.delta
entries.doc: The game's own frame delta (with slow motion).

entries.name: game.level
entries.doc: The current level (GetCurrentLevel: its load script checksum and level structure).

entries.name: game.paused
entries.doc: True while the game is paused.

entries.name: save.get
entries.doc: This mod's own save data (JSON in <mods>/_modsave/<mod id>/save.json, never the game's saves).

entries.name: save.set
entries.doc: Stores a JSON-compatible value; written within 10 s, at reload / exit, or with save.flush().

entries.name: save.data
entries.doc: The whole save table (edit in place).

entries.name: save.flush
entries.doc: Writes the save data now.

entries.name: mod.id
entries.doc: This mod's id (mod.json).

entries.name: mod.info
entries.doc: This mod's mod.json as a table (mod.info.config = its settings).

entries.name: mod.read
entries.doc: Reads a file of the mod folder (relative path).

entries.name: mod.json
entries.doc: Reads and decodes a JSON file of the mod folder.

entries.name: mod.list
entries.doc: Lists a folder of the mod (folders end in /).

entries.name: mod.export
entries.doc: Makes fn callable from the live link / editor (mod.call) and native plugins.

entries.name: require
entries.doc: Loads scripts/<name with . as />.lua of this mod, else a built-in library (peds, ...).

entries.name: json.encode
entries.doc: Value to JSON.

entries.name: json.decode
entries.doc: JSON to value.

entries.name: log.info
entries.doc: Writes to the game log (and the editor console) with file:line. print() does the same.

entries.name: log.warn
entries.doc: Warning line.

entries.name: log.error
entries.doc: Error line.

entries.name: livelink.emit
entries.doc: Sends an event to connected live-link clients (the editor).

entries.name: livelink.active
entries.doc: True if a live-link client is connected.

entries.name: mem.u8
entries.signature: mem.u8(addr) (also u16 u32 s32 f32 f64 vec cstr)
entries.doc: Typed reads of guest memory (big-endian handled).

entries.name: mem.write_u32
entries.doc: Typed writes, only to game data and heaps (not code, stacks or device memory).

entries.name: frame
entries.doc: Every game frame.

entries.name: trick
entries.doc: A trick was shown in the trick text (trick started).

entries.name: trick_landed
entries.signature: trick_landed {score, base, mult, tricks = {{name, points}}, total, last, pos}
entries.doc: A combo was landed (banked).

entries.name: combo
entries.signature: combo {score, base, mult, landed, tricks, total, last, pos}
entries.doc: A combo ended, landed or bailed.

entries.name: combo_end
entries.signature: combo_end {score, base, mult, landed, total, last}
entries.doc: Raw combo end (no trick list).

entries.name: combo_start
entries.doc: A combo started (first trick).

entries.name: bail
entries.doc: The skater bailed.

entries.name: landed
entries.doc: The skater landed (every landing, also without tricks).

entries.name: grind_start
entries.doc: Rail grind state entered / left.

entries.name: manual_start
entries.doc: Manual entered / left.

entries.name: lip_start
entries.doc: Lip trick state entered / left.

entries.name: air_start
entries.doc: Left the ground / came back down (also wall_start/_end, ground_start/_end).

entries.name: gap
entries.doc: A gap was hit (EndGap).

entries.name: gap_first
entries.doc: A gap was found for the first time (career).

entries.name: secret_spot
entries.doc: A secret spot was found.

entries.name: goal_started
entries.doc: A goal was activated.

entries.name: goal_completed
entries.doc: A goal was won (stock or modding-kit goal).

entries.name: goal_failed
entries.doc: A goal was failed.

entries.name: goal_quit
entries.doc: A modding-kit goal was quit.

entries.name: goal_ended
entries.doc: A goal was deactivated (after a win, a loss or quitting).

entries.name: level_loading
entries.doc: A level starts loading (load_level).

entries.name: level_ready
entries.doc: The level is playable (GameFlow_PlayRun; also at the start of each run).

entries.name: level_unload
entries.doc: The level is about to be left (cleanup_before_changing_level).

entries.name: zone_loaded
entries.doc: A streamed zone came in (Zones_PakMan_Init).

entries.name: zone_unloaded
entries.doc: A streamed zone went out.

entries.name: pause
entries.doc: The game was paused / unpaused (also by menus that pause).

entries.name: menu
entries.doc: The UI state changed (Fsm_Set: uistate_pausemenu, uistate_gameplay, ...).

entries.name: ped_near
entries.doc: The skater came near a ped who can talk (talk prompt).

entries.name: ped_talk
entries.doc: The player started a ped conversation.

entries.name: speech_box
entries.doc: A speech box opened.

entries.name: career
entries.doc: Career progress changed (CareerFunc: AddGoalPoints, FoundSecretSpot, ...).

entries.name: rank_up
entries.doc: Career rank went up.

entries.name: game_saved
entries.doc: The game saved (SaveToMemoryCard).

entries.name: game_loaded
entries.doc: A save was loaded (LoadFromMemoryCard).

entries.name: button
entries.doc: A watched pad button changed (input.watch).

entries.name: unload
entries.doc: This mod is about to be unloaded (reload / exit): undo changes to the game here.

entries.name: shutdown
entries.doc: The game is exiting.

entries.name: script:<name>
entries.doc: Any QB script starts (spawned, goto, run from C or called from another script).

entries.name: cfunc:<name>
entries.doc: Any QB CFunction returned.

entries.name: event:<name>
entries.doc: Any game event (LaunchEvent / BroadcastEvent / exceptions).

entries.name: skater.state
entries.doc: The skater's movement state: "ground", "air", "wall", "lip", "rail", "wallplant", "stall" or "tiretap" (SkaterState component), walking (off the board), doing_trick.

entries.name: skater.trick
entries.doc: The trick last shown in the trick text and its points.

entries.name: skater.stance
entries.doc: The current stance (switch-aware: Skater:flipped).

entries.name: world.create
entries.doc: Creates a level object from its node (the game's Create).

entries.name: world.kill
entries.doc: Removes a level object (Kill).

entries.name: world.exists
entries.doc: True if an object with this id exists (ObjectExists).

entries.name: world.node_flag
entries.doc: Turns a node flag (a group of level objects) on or off (ChangeNodeFlag).

entries.name: world.global_flag
entries.doc: Reads (no second argument) or sets a global flag (GetGlobalFlag / SetGlobalFlag / UnSetGlobalFlag).

entries.name: camera.look
entries.signature: camera.look{pos, at = "Skater", fov = 72, name = "modapi_cam", time, hold = true}
entries.doc: A held in-game camera at pos looking at an object (morphs over time, default at once); camera.stop(name) returns to gameplay. Its control script is a qb.script the game runs on the camera object.
